newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur, ARAG merge legal protection.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur, ARAG merge legal protection.

text.p: Swiss insurer Winterthur Group said it was merging its legal insurance unit with Germany's ARAG Allgemeinen Rechtschutz-Versicherungs AG on January 1, 1998.
"The two legal assistance specialists will together become the largest provider of this insurance type in Switzerland," Winterthur said in statement.
Winterthur said the boards of Winterthur and ARAG had approved the merger.
ARAG is the largest legal assistance insurer in Europe and participated in the creation of Winterthur Legal Assistance Insurance Co. in 1978.
With the merger, ARAG will take over a substantial stake in the new Winterthur-ARAG Legal Assistance.
A spokeswoman declined to specify the stake of ARAG in the new unit, which will be part of the Winterthur Schweiz division.
The merger only affects the activities of Winterthur and ARAG, Zurich, in Switzerland, she added.
